title: Earth's potential well
caption: φ = −GM/r is negative everywhere and rises towards 0 at infinity. At the surface φ = −62.56 MJ kg⁻¹; at 400 km it is −58.87. The difference, 3.70 MJ kg⁻¹, times 1000 kg is the 3.7 GJ needed to lift the satellite.
alt: Graph of gravitational potential against distance from Earth's centre: a curve rising from minus 62.6 megajoules per kilogram at the surface towards zero. Points at the surface and 400 kilometres up are marked.
description: The horizontal axis is distance from Earth's centre in thousands of km; the vertical axis is potential φ in MJ kg⁻¹.
φ = −GM/r with GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³ s⁻². At r = R = 6371 km, φ = −62.56 MJ kg⁻¹.
At r = R + 400 km = 6771 km, φ = −58.87 MJ kg⁻¹.
Work to lift 1000 kg = m Δφ = 1000 × 3.70 × 10⁶ J = 3.7 GJ.
